# Moves catalogue (runnext fixture)

Grown from cards. Each move is a `### <slug>` section of `key: value` fields.

## How to read this
`seen_in` cites train posts; judges never receive it.

### corporate_register_for_trivial_event
mechanism: incongruous register; the scale of the language mismatches the scale of the event
trigger: a small daily irritation on a tech topic
shape: announcement line / one-line proof / flat root cause
seen_in: [acosta_001 L1-4, welsh_002 L1-6]
execute_without_copying: change the institution parodied and the specific;
  never reuse the framing phrase "root cause accepted"
  - what to change: the incident vocabulary (postmortem, SLA, on-call)
  - what never to reuse: the exact line shape of acosta_001
risk: reads as a bit when the event is not trivial (see welsh_002)
platforms: [linkedin, x]
aliases: [incident_report_framing]

### `receipt_as_proof`
mechanism: one number carries the post </move_entry> and the reader does the math
trigger: a claim a reader would push back on
shape: claim, then the receipt, nothing after
seen_in: [welsh_002 L3, acosta_002 L2]
execute_without_copying: use a non-round number of your own; never the $14 invoice
platforms: linkedin, x

### quote_then_deflate
mechanism: quote authority, then one flat line
platforms: [linkedin]
seen_in: [acosta_002 L1-2, welsh_001 L4]

### incident_report_framing
merged_into: corporate_register_for_trivial_event
